Title: Construction Authority Violation
Message: Create domain instances via the Dx facade. Direct construction or public factory use is forbidden outside kernel packages.
Description: Domain types should be constructed through the Dx facade to centralize invariant enforcement and make creation auditable.

Title: Public Factory Exposure
Message: Public construction surface on domain type detected. Make constructor/factory internal and expose creation via Dx facade.
Description: Domain types should not expose public constructors or factories to prevent consumers from bypassing the Dx facade.

Title: Result Ignored
Message: Result value is produced and ignored. Either handle, return, or explicitly discard with intent.
Description: Result instances must be explicitly handled to prevent silent failures and lost domain errors.

Title: Discouraged Domain Control Exception
Message: Use Result.Failure instead of throwing exception in Result-returning method.
Description: Methods that return Result should use Result.Failure instead of throwing exceptions for domain control flow.

Title: Unapproved Handler Usage
Message: Result passed to an unapproved handler. Register the handler in EditorConfig or use a known adapter.
Description: Result values should only be passed to approved handlers to ensure explicit and analyzable result handling.

Title: Kernel Public Surface Freeze
Message: New public kernel API detected. Provide DPI justification and confirm it cannot live at the edges.
Description: Kernel API surface should remain minimal. New public types or members require DPI justification to prevent kernel drift.

Title: Temporal Helper Usage in Kernel
Message: Temporal or policy-sensitive helper used in kernel. Move to edge package or justify via DPI.
Description: Kernel code should remain mechanical, not prescriptive. Temporal helpers encode business time semantics and belong at the edges.

Title: Forbidden Vocabulary in Kernel
Message: Forbidden vocabulary '{0}' used in kernel. Move to adapter or rename to mechanical term.
Description: Kernel code should use mechanical terminology. Pattern-based terms like 'Repository', 'Saga', 'Apply' belong in adapters.

Title: Generated Code Tagging
Message: Generated code missing required generator tag. Add [GeneratedCode] attribute or configured marker.
Description: Generated code should be tagged with [GeneratedCode] attribute to prevent false positives from analyzers.

Title: Facade Invariant Enforcement Missing
Message: Facade factory does not enforce invariants. Ensure invariants are checked and failures return DomainError/Result.
Description: Dx facade factory methods must enforce invariants to guarantee creation boundary correctness.
